sentences.text: Dattatri vs State Of Telangana, on 12 July, 2024
Author: K. Lakshman Bench: K.Lakshman  HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K.LAKSHMAN  WRIT PETITION No.18443 of 2024 ORAL ORDER:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Somu Srinivas Reddy, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and Sri P. Shashi Kiran, learned counsel for respondent No.5.
2.

The petitioner herein is claiming that he and his brother has purchased land admeasuring Ac.6-20 gts in Sy.Nos.243/A1, 243/A2, 243/A3 and 243/A4, situated at Zaheerabad Village and Mandal, Sangareddy District and his share comes to Ac.3-20 gts.
He is in possession of the subject property.
While the matter stood thus, respondent No.5 has acquired certain land for laying railway track.

They are not informing the petitioner with regard to details of the land acquired, extent,
compensation paid etc.
Therefore, petitioner herein has submitted representation dated 19.02.2024 to the respondent No.2 during prajavani and also reminder dated 04.03.2024.
Despite receiving and acknowledging the said representations, respondent No.2 did not act upon the same.
3. Whereas, vide proceedings undated of April, 2024, respondent No.3 requested Railway Land Acquisition Officer, Zaheerabad to furnish the details.
Vide letter dated 15.04.2024, respondent No.5 informed the respondent No.3 to address a letter to the Headquarters, Secunderabad and he has also furnished the address.

The aforesaid facts would reveal that petitioner herein is seeking information with regard to details of acquisition of land etc from the Public Information Officer of Revenue department under RTI Act.

Therefore, he has to submit appropriate application in terms of Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 to the Public Information Officer of concerned office and it is for the said office to consider and furnish information to the petitioner herein.
He cannot submit representation in prajavani to the respondent No.2 and seek information under the Act.
He has to follow the procedure laid down under RTI Act, 2005.

4. In the light of the aforesaid discussion, this Writ Petition is disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to submit appropriate application in terms of Section 6(1) of the RTI Act, 2005 to the concerned Public Information Officer who in-turn will consider the same and furnish information in accordance with law.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in the Writ Petition shall stand closed.

K. LAKSHMAN, J 12.07.2024 ssy Dattatri vs State Of Telangana, on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41370981/
